jobgether-jobgether:lever:0e25b1ce-86be-.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0e25b1ce-86be-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager based in the United States. This is a strategic customer success leadership opportunity focused on complex, high-value enterprise accounts within a fast-moving SaaS environment. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes and maximize return on investment. The role combines relationship management, renewal strategy, product adoption, account expansion, and technical problem-solving. You will own multi-year success plans, lead executive-level business reviews, and proactively manage customer health and retention risks. Working closely with Sales, Product, Support, Engineering, and Implementation, you will influence both customer outcomes and internal processes. You will also mentor fellow CSMs and help establish best practices across the broader customer success organization. Own strategic account planning for a portfolio of complex enterprise customers, developing and executing multi-year success plans connected to measurable business outcomes and ROI. Build trusted-advisor relationships with Director-, VP-, and C-level stakeholders by understanding their objectives and aligning solutions with broader business priorities. Manage the renewal lifecycle end to end, including forecasting, health scores, usage trends, risk identification, and proactive churn mitigation. Analyze customer satisfaction data, KPIs, adoption metrics, and account health indicators to identify opportunities and risks. Identify expansion opportunities by uncovering underutilized capabilities and increasing product adoption, while partnering with Sales on upsell and cross-sell initiatives. Serve as the primary escalation point for at-risk or highly complex accounts, coordinating internal resources and implementing recovery strategies. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews that demonstrate customer value, assess strategic alignment, and identify optimization and growth opportunities. Collaborate with Product, Support, Engineering, Sales, and Implementation teams to resolve customer challenges, improve service delivery, and advocate for customer needs. Champion customer feedback and ensure insights are communicated effectively to inform product improvements, service enhancements, and roadmap decisions. Develop and improve customer success processes that increase team efficiency, strengthen customer outcomes, and support scalable growth. Mentor fellow Customer Success Managers by sharing best practices in account planning, executive engagement, renewal management, and escalation handling. Use modern CRM, customer success, and AI-enabled tools to monitor sentiment, analyze account health, and improve customer engagement. Requirements: 5–10+ years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS, Technical Account Management, or a comparable client-facing role, with a strong track record managing complex enterprise accounts. Strong technical aptitude, ideally including knowledge of networking concepts, Wi-Fi infrastructure, network topology, or broader IT environments. Demonstrated success driving customer retention, relationship development, product adoption, and account growth within enterprise portfolios. Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect product usage, customer outcomes, revenue growth, and ROI. Executive-level communication skills and presence, with experience leading QBRs and communicating technical concepts clearly to Director-, VP-, and C-suite stakeholders. Proven ownership of renewal forecasting, customer health scoring, churn prevention, and risk management. Experience working with CRM and Customer Success platforms such as HubSpot or Zendesk, as well as modern AI tools for sentiment analysis and customer health tracking. Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8d869d7e-3ab3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Manager - IBM National Practice based in the United States. This role leads a sales team responsible for driving growth, profitability, and customer outcomes within a defined technology sales segment. You will manage and develop Account Managers, Account Executives, and/or Client Executives while translating broader business goals into actionable sales plans. The position combines hands-on people leadership with territory planning, performance management, customer engagement, and partner collaboration. You will coach sales professionals to strengthen their capabilities, improve execution, and connect technology solutions to measurable customer outcomes. Success requires strong commercial judgment, comfort with sales data, and the ability to adapt priorities as market conditions and organizational needs evolve. As a people leader, you will also help foster an AI-fluent culture by encouraging responsible experimentation, continuous learning, and effective use of emerging tools. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on team performance while building lasting customer and partner relationships in a fast-paced technology environment. Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Managers, Account Executives, and/or Client Executives, including hiring, onboarding, retention, performance management, and career development. Establish clear expectations and provide regular coaching, feedback, and guidance to improve individual and team sales performance. Develop and assign sales plans and territories aligned with segment objectives, customer needs, and available resources. Execute operating plans that support revenue, profitability, and sales growth targets. Monitor team performance through relevant metrics, sales activity, and business results, using data to identify opportunities and adjust tactics. Oversee customer relationships and help ensure a consistently strong customer experience across the sales cycle. Collaborate with field sales organizations, technology partners, and vendor stakeholders to strengthen opportunities and deliver customer outcomes. Help the team apply segment-specific strategies, understand customer challenges, and effectively position relevant technology solutions. Coach sales professionals to use outcome-based selling approaches and connect solutions to measurable business results. Optimize territory coverage, account prioritization, and resource allocation within the assigned team. Lead the team through organizational changes, new initiatives, and ambiguity while maintaining clear communication, accountability, and operating discipline. Encourage responsible adoption of AI tools and practices to improve sales strategy, decision-making, productivity, and team capabilities. Maintain a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, curiosity, and high performance. Requirements: 5+ years of relevant sales experience, with experience in technology solutions, services, or a related environment. 0–3 years of formal people-management experience, or equivalent leadership experience within a sales organization. Associate’s degree or equivalent professional experience; candidates with substantial sales management experience may be considered in lieu of formal education. Strong knowledge of sales planning, territory management, customer relationship development, and performance management. Excellent communication, interpersonal, coaching, and team-motivation skills. Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, retain, and manage diverse sales talent. Proficiency with CRM systems and sales technology, with the ability to use sales data and market trends to guide decisions. Strong understanding of technology products and services and the ability to translate their value into customer outcomes. southparkcommons-meesho:lever:ae2aa625-4.description: About the Team ValMo is Meesho's logistics and supply chain organization, building India's most cost-efficient, reliable, and scalable fulfillment network. From first-mile pickup to last-mile delivery and reverse logistics, ValMo powers millions of shipments every month for small businesses across the country. As we scale, network complexity grows exponentially. ValMo sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and partner ecosystems — where execution precision and systems thinking are critical to prevent cascading failures across the network. About the Role Lead the national expansion of our Latent Last Mile network — a hyperlocal delivery model that taps into "latent" capacity: shopkeepers, water vendors, students, security guards, and domestic help etc. who deliver during time available around their primary work, earning a secondary income. Lead the national expansion of our Latent Last Mile network — a hyperlocal delivery model that taps into "latent" capacity: shopkeepers, water vendors, students, and domestic help who deliver during time available around their primary work and earn a secondary income. This is a national-level role reporting into senior leadership, where you'll shape the operations strategy for scaling this network across India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem. southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:7147a57.title: Data Analyst Intern
southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:7147a57.description: Where multiple locations are listed for this role, the position may be based in any of those locations, with priority determined according to the order of listing. Agents generate an unusual amount of data: every run, every step, every recovery from failure. Buried in that data is the answer to which agent behaviors actually work and where users get stuck. Not enough of it is being read today. You'll own analysis that shapes what we build next, working directly with product and engineering. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and maintain dashboards that track product health: activation, retention, task success, and agent reliability - Analyze agent run data to find where tasks fail, stall, or need human rescue - Answer product questions with data, and be honest when the data can't answer them - Help define and instrument the events and metrics we should be tracking in the first place - Support experiment design and read out results without overclaiming - Turn analysis into recommendations, with a clear view of what you'd do next - Make your work reproducible so others can build on it YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF - You're pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience - You're solid with SQL and comfortable in Python or R for analysis - You've built a dashboard or analysis someone else actually used - You understand the basics of experimentation and are appropriately skeptical of noisy results - You can explain a finding to someone who won't read the notebook - You're curious about the product, not just the numbers Bonus: experience with product analytics tools, dbt, or working with event data at scale

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:6d867c61-32f.title: Translation Validator | Odia
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:6d867c61-32f.description: About the Role Welo Data is seeking experienced linguists to support a synthetic data generation program for a leading technology client. In this role, you will perform A/B preference testing of machine-generated translations from English into Indic languages, helping to evaluate and improve the quality of AI-generated content. As a Translation Validator, you will independently review an English source document alongside two machine-generated translations (Variant A and Variant B), select the preferred translation, and provide a written justification for your choice. Each sample is reviewed by three independent validators working in a blind process. Project Details Job Title: TL Validation for Indic Languages Location: Remote Commitment: 2 weeks Employment Type: Freelance Contract Start day: ASAP Pay Rate: $3.80/hour
qualifications: Native-level fluency in Odia (written and spoken) .
Strong written communication skills in the target language.
Proficiency in English.
Background in linguistics, translation, or language quality assessment preferred.
Ability to work independently with high attention to detail and consistency.
Familiarity with Romanized script conventions for the relevant language is a plus (for transliteration tasks).
